text: 其中提到，推动关键核心技术攻关。支持围绕工业垂类大模型、AI编程大模型、物理AI、工业智能体、工业软件、工业互联网等前沿领域，突破知识图谱融合、文生三维零部件设计等技术，最高支持2000万元。推动研发面向工业大模型及智能体的安全综合解决方案，最高支持1000万元。降低智能要素使用成本。鼓励工业智算云平台向制造企业提供低代码智能体开发平台、工业智能体的免费试用，发放平台Token体验券，推出算力惠企方案。
text_en: It mentioned promoting breakthroughs in key core technologies. Support for breakthroughs in knowledge graph fusion, text-to-3D part design and other technologies, focusing on frontier areas such as industrial vertical large models, AI coding large models, physical AI, industrial intelligent agents, industrial software, and industrial internet, with a maximum support of RMB 20 million. Promote R&D of security comprehensive solutions for industrial large models and agents, with a maximum support of RMB 10 million. Reduce the cost of using intelligent elements. Encourage industrial intelligent computing cloud platforms to provide manufacturing enterprises with low-code agent development platforms, free trials of industrial agents, issue platform Token experience vouchers, and launch computing power preferential plans for enterprises.
